_doc: Wilderness set pieces, round 3 (agent X): Camp Tamarack, Elk Ridge Lodge, the Cordon quarantine camp and the Haldane Place. Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_wild3.py. Only w3_signs is a new texture (textures/gen/wild3.py, an atlas whose cells the generator maps); the rest tint shared sets: the lodge's bark-on logs, the lime chinking and mortar between them and the fieldstone, the Cordon's olive-drab canvas. Shared ids reused by these props: wild_log_bark, wood_log_end, out_log_peeled, out_chinking, stone_river, out_antler, fur_deer, wild_fur_dark, eye_animal, canvas_*, plastic_*, paint_*, metal_galvanized, chainlink, t3_trailer_white, road_*, farm_corrugated_*, wood_weathered, out_earth and the glow materials.
